marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 與你的潛意識和解 : 肯定真實的自己, 開啟幸福人生 = あなたは、あなたなりに生きれば良い | Yu ni de qian yi shi he jie : ken ding zhen shi de zi ji, kai qi xing fu ren sheng = あなたは、あなたなりに生きれば良い

In this world, some people experience smooth sailing in life, while others gradually face hardship. But do we truly understand the reason behind misfortune? The pain we experience in life often stems from conflicts within our subconscious—what we call inner obstacles. For those whose lives seem to be turning toward misfortune, a simple shift in perspective can actually lead to happiness. However, for many people, even that "small shift" is not easy to achieve. Whether or not a person can slightly change the way they view things can determine the course of their entire life. In other words, a person’s subconscious ultimately shapes their destiny
